P.expected_type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (GP.Space n)) (h_H001 : 0 ≤ n) (h_H002 : E.Nonempty) (h_H003 : IsCompact E), dimH (GP.cylinder E) = dimH E + 1

correspondence.explanation: For every natural n (the original nonnegative integer) and every subset E of Euclidean R^n, the retained hypotheses 0≤n, E.Nonempty and IsCompact E are exactly H001–H003, including the approved nonemptiness addition. GP.Space n has the L2 Euclidean metric. The first n and last coordinates give mutually inverse identifications of GP.cylinder E with E×[0,1]; GP.join appends the last coordinate, including when n=0. Thus the target uses precisely the source Euclidean R^(n+1) subset, not a different product norm. Native dimH is D004, with ENNReal addition of one; T001 identifies the supplied unnormalized H with native measure at positive exponents. Parameters remain universally exported, and no extra assumptions or external premises are added.
